QuestInfo.name: [Ribbon Pig] A Mark of Strength?
QuestInfo.0: There was nothing strange about the ribbons. Talk to #b#p9000292##k to think of something else.
QuestInfo.1: You got information on pigs from the Ribbon Pig community. You also got some information on Wild Boars. Report back to #b#p9000292##k.
QuestInfo.2: The ribbons on the Ribbon Pigs symbolize their strength. Talk to #b#p9000292##k about Wild Boars too.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\r\nCan proceed to [Ribbon Pigs & Wild Boars] Boardom\r\n

0.0: I've got some good information on where you can find the pigs. Ready?\r\n#r<< You will go into display mode when you accept. >>

yes.0: Take this. It should help you understand their speech. The table lists their oink frequencies and rhythms. Now, get going!

1.0: Hm, so the ribbons are like martial arts belts that show how strong they are... And here I thought they were just accessories. Do you think I should get one of those ribbons and try to look tougher?
1.1: I guess it's red belt, blue belt... Kind of like ranks in martial arts.
1.2: Now, let's consider the fact that the pigs were talking about boars. While researching the monster's ecology and characteristics, I found out that they're often concentrated in the mountains. That's where we should search next.
1.3: Talk to me when you're ready. I'll tell you some spots I suspect the pigs gather at.
